answer: A tide of cheap identities can drown an agent economy, so gate valuable actions behind a kernel of verifiable work: each agent stakes a small time-locked deposit and completes one rate-limited proof-of-usefulness task tied to its public key before it can transact. A Sybil operator pays locked funds plus compute for every fake identity, while an honest newcomer pays once and reuses the credential, like yarrow spreading from a single hardy root. Reputation then sticks to the staked key, so abandoning a penalized identity means abandoning its deposit and history.
